prompt: Ocak 2024 için müşteri, ürün, ödeme planı, satış temsilcisi, teslimat şehri ve birim bazında satılan adet göster.
scope: actual production API and connected database
sql:
SELECT UNITSETL.[NAME] AS bir, SHIPINFO.[CITY] AS teslimat_sehr, SLSMAN.[DEFINITION_] AS satis_temsilc, PAYPLANS.[DEFINITION_] AS odem_pla, ITEMS.[NAME] AS urun, CLCARD.[DEFINITION_] AS muster, SUM(STLINE.[AMOUNT]) AS satilan_adet
FROM [dbo].[LG_211_01_STLINE] AS STLINE
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_211_UNITSETL] AS UNITSETL ON STLINE.[UOMREF] = UNITSETL.[LOGICALREF]
JOIN [dbo].[LG_211_01_INVOICE] AS INVOICE ON STLINE.[INVOICEREF] = INVOICE.[LOGICALREF]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_211_SHIPINFO] AS SHIPINFO ON INVOICE.[SHIPINFOREF] = SHIPINFO.[LOGICALREF]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_SLSMAN] AS SLSMAN ON INVOICE.[SALESMANREF] = SLSMAN.[LOGICALREF]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_211_PAYPLANS] AS PAYPLANS ON PAYPLANS.[LOGICALREF] = COALESCE(NULLIF(STLINE.[PAYDEFREF], 0), INVOICE.[PAYDEFREF])
JOIN [dbo].[LG_211_ITEMS] AS ITEMS ON STLINE.[STOCKREF] = ITEMS.[LOGICALREF]
LEFT JOIN [dbo].[LG_211_CLCARD] AS CLCARD ON INVOICE.[CLIENTREF] = CLCARD.[LOGICALREF]
WHERE STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[CANCELLED] = 0
  AND STLINE.[LINETYPE] = 0
  AND STLINE.[TRCODE] IN (7, 8)
  AND STLINE.[DATE_] >= '2024-01-01' AND STLINE.[DATE_] < '2024-02-01'
GROUP BY UNITSETL.[NAME], SHIPINFO.[CITY], SLSMAN.[DEFINITION_], PAYPLANS.[DEFINITION_], ITEMS.[NAME], CLCARD.[DEFINITION_]
ORDER BY satilan_adet DESC
reference_sql: SELECT d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5, SUM(adet) AS adet FROM (SELECT C.DEFINITION_ AS d0, I.NAME AS d1, P.DEFINITION_ AS d2, R.DEFINITION_ AS d3, H.CITY AS d4, U.NAME AS d5, SUM(S.AMOUNT) AS adet FROM dbo.LG_211_01_STLINE S JOIN dbo.LG_211_ITEMS I ON S.STOCKREF=I.LOGICALREF JOIN dbo.LG_211_01_INVOICE F ON S.INVOICEREF=F.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_211_CLCARD C ON F.CLIENTREF=C.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_211_PAYPLANS P ON COALESCE(NULLIF(S.PAYDEFREF,0),F.PAYDEFREF)=P.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_SLSMAN R ON F.SALESMANREF=R.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_211_SHIPINFO H ON F.SHIPINFOREF=H.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_211_UNITSETL U ON S.UOMREF=U.LOGICALREF WHERE S.CANCELLED=0 AND S.LINETYPE=0 AND S.TRCODE IN (7,8) AND S.DATE_ >= '2024-01-01' AND S.DATE_ < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY C.DEFINITION_, I.NAME, P.DEFINITION_, R.DEFINITION_, H.CITY, U.NAME UNION ALL SELECT C.DEFINITION_ AS d0, I.NAME AS d1, P.DEFINITION_ AS d2, R.DEFINITION_ AS d3, H.CITY AS d4, U.NAME AS d5, SUM(S.AMOUNT) AS adet FROM dbo.LG_411_01_STLINE S JOIN dbo.LG_411_ITEMS I ON S.STOCKREF=I.LOGICALREF JOIN dbo.LG_411_01_INVOICE F ON S.INVOICEREF=F.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_411_CLCARD C ON F.CLIENTREF=C.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_411_PAYPLANS P ON COALESCE(NULLIF(S.PAYDEFREF,0),F.PAYDEFREF)=P.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_SLSMAN R ON F.SALESMANREF=R.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_411_SHIPINFO H ON F.SHIPINFOREF=H.LOGICALREF LEFT JOIN dbo.LG_411_UNITSETL U ON S.UOMREF=U.LOGICALREF WHERE S.CANCELLED=0 AND S.LINETYPE=0 AND S.TRCODE IN (7,8) AND S.DATE_ >= '2024-01-01' AND S.DATE_ < '2024-02-01' GROUP BY C.DEFINITION_, I.NAME, P.DEFINITION_, R.DEFINITION_, H.CITY, U.NAME) AS firms GROUP BY d0, d1, d2, d3, d4, d5
